output.name: Stale vault check-outs blocking CAD edits (absent/departed owners)
output.summary: Engineers cannot edit or save CAD parts, assemblies and drawings because the vault shows them checked out by colleagues who are on leave or have left, and they wait about a day for an admin to force an undo check-out.

root_cause.text: Likely the vault has no expiry, reassignment or offboarding/leave handling for check-outs, so locks held by absent or departed users persist until a vault admin manually forces an undo check-out with manager approval.

quotes.quote: G. Brennan has had busbar_122.prt checked out for two weeks and is on leave.
Need mount_937.prt unlocked, owner left the company
Vault admin forced undo check-out after manager approval.

evidence.text: Many tickets describe files held for two weeks by owners who are on leave, across different users and file types.

quotes.quote: N. Kowalski has had housing_626.prt checked out for two weeks and is on leave.
M. Garcia has had busbar_130.drw checked out for two weeks and is on leave.
B. Osei has had mount_266.asm checked out for two weeks and is on leave.

evidence.text: Several tickets report the lock owner has left the company, meaning the lock can never be released by its holder.

quotes.quote: Need housing_147.asm unlocked, owner left the company
Need housing_765.asm unlocked, owner left the company

evidence.text: Users also hit the lock only at save time, losing the ability to save edits they already made.

quotes.quote: Cannot save my changes to bracket_976.drw; vault says it is locked.
Cannot save my changes to mount_786.asm; vault says it is locked.

evidence.text: Every ticket was resolved the same manual way, a forced undo check-out by a vault admin after manager approval.

quotes.quote: Vault admin forced undo check-out after manager approval.
Vault admin forced undo check-out after manager approval.

output.fix: Add check-out lifecycle rules to the vault: automatically release or reassign check-outs held beyond a set age or by users flagged as on leave/offboarded (tied to the HR leave/offboarding process), with notification to the owner and their manager, so stale locks are cleared without a support ticket.
